The employee also has no authority to grant a discretionary exception, and the manager explicitly instructed the team to release the full batch. Delaying the manifest would leave all 60 boxes undispatched, make the shift incomplete, and worsen the centre’s target without preserving Alex’s box.

In practice, the employee might flag the Wednesday collection or contact the duty manager, but would still release the manifest by 13:30 unless an authorized duty manager registered written permission beforehand. Consequently, Alex’s correspondence and photographs would be irreversibly destroyed that afternoon.
